🌍 Eight tribes. Eight extraordinary cultures. Countless traditions that most of the world has never discovered!
From the legendary Maasai warriors to the mysterious Ogiek honey hunters and the fascinating El Molo fishing community, which tribe surprised you the most?
If you could spend one day experiencing one of these unique cultures, which tribe would you choose and why? 🤔
👇 Share your answer in the comments! We would love to hear your thoughts.

🌎 Keep exploring. The world is full of amazing discoveries!
